overall: The AG found no violation: the Committee had a reasonable basis to withhold the specific threatened litigation from its May 1 executive session notice and announcement, though it reminded the Committee to generally identify litigation matters. The purpose-switch allegation was not reviewed because the complainant did not pursue it.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Committee failed to identify the specific litigation matter it discussed in executive session at its May 1 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Based on the responses from the Committee and discussion with the Committee’s legal counsel, we are satisfied that the Committee has demonstrated a reasonable basis for its claim that identifying the specific litigation matter may have compromised the purpose for the executive session, which was to protect the Committee’s litigating position with respect to the threatened litigation.

allegations.summary: Complaint also alleged the Committee should have used the discipline-related purpose (a)(1) rather than the litigation purpose (a)(3) for the May 1 executive session.
allegations.key_passage: We understand from the request made to our office that the Complainant only seeks review of the allegation that the Committee failed to identify the litigation matter to be discussed.
